rolesObserved: creatorGates(currentSession).isCreator — required by all three routes (create/page, create/library/page, create/new/page); accountType must be 'creator' AND a non-null creator record must exist, else an EmptyState routes the user to /onboarding

creatorGates(currentSession).canUpload (derived from creator.subscriptionPaid) — the second, independent gate checked by all three routes after isCreator; false routes to /subscription. KYC status is explicitly NOT checked anywhere in this screen — awaitingKyc creators reach the wizard/hub/library normally.
PublishingWizard additionally reads gates.slotsUsed/gates.slotsTotal (post-isCreator/canUpload) to compute and display 'Uses slot N of T' — not a gate itself.

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: creatorGates(currentSession).isCreator === false, i.e. currentSession.accountType !== 'creator' or creator is null
uiStatesHandled.reachable: unknown — currentSession is a single mutable mock singleton hardcoded to accountType:'creator' with a non-null creator object (src/lib/api/mocks/session.ts). The only way to flip accountType to 'user' at runtime today is the DEV-ONLY setAccountType() switch (STUB-1, stubs.json), which is not wired to any real signup/account-type-selection flow reachable from these three files. Once a real backend supplies session.accountType, this state becomes reachable in production for genuine user-account visitors; today it is reachable only via the dev switch.

unknown — same constraint as above: currentSession.creator.subscriptionPaid is hardcoded true and the only mutator is the DEV-ONLY setSubscriptionPaid() switch (STUB-1). CreatorOnboarding.tsx also mutates this directly rather than through subscriptionApi (STUB-3), so even the 'real' onboarding flow bypasses an API round trip. Reachable in production only once a real subscription-purchase endpoint sets this server-side.

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: isCreator && canUpload && slotsUsed < slotsTotal (slotFree prop true)
uiStatesHandled.reachable: yes — default mock session state (pro tier, slotsUsed:4 of 7) lands here directly.

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: user taps any content-type tile or the 'Continue with video' CTA while slotFree is false (slotsUsed >= slotsTotal); component-local useState, not derived from a fresh API read
uiStatesHandled.reachable: yes, but only by first using the DEV-ONLY tier/slot switches to push slotsUsed to slotsTotal, since the default mock session (4 of 7) starts with room. Once real usage accrues via real publishes this is naturally reachable.

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: items === null, i.e. between mount and contentApi.getLibrary() resolving
uiStatesHandled.reachable: yes — always passed through briefly since mockRequest has a simulated delay; will remain reachable with a real async GET.

unknown in mock mode — the mock getLibrary() (mockRequest([...libraryItems])) never rejects, so this state is currently unreachable through normal use; only a real backend returning a 4xx/5xx (or a thrown network error once try-fetch is live) would trigger it. Structurally wired correctly, just never exercised today.

uiStatesHandled.state: ContentLibrary — empty (implicit: filtered list renders nothing)
uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: items resolves to [] or the active status filter matches zero items
uiStatesHandled.reachable: yes for the filter case (e.g. filtering to 'rejected' when nothing is rejected is trivially reachable by picking a tab); the true empty-list case (items.length === 0) is unreachable in mock mode because libraryItems is a hardcoded non-empty array with no delete/remove action wired anywhere in this screen. Note: there is no dedicated EmptyState render for either case — the item map simply produces nothing, no explicit empty-state UI exists for this screen's library list.

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: default wizard entry state, or after Submitted→'Upload another'
user taps 'Set the preview' from step 0
firstUpload prop true (derived: resubmitItem.isFirstUpload, or searchParams.first==='1', or !hasPublished i.e. no library item has status 'live' yet)
uiStatesHandled.reachable: yes via direct URL (?first=1) or by reaching /create/new with a mock session/library state with zero 'live' items; the default mock library already has one 'live' item so hasPublished is true by default — reachable mainly via query param or after manipulating mock data.

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: firstUpload=false; user has independent Free/Paid segmented control, defaults to Paid (paid=!firstUpload)
submit() called, publishing=true until contentApi.publish() settles

contentApi.publish() throws — mock throws ApiError in three cases: (a) creator is null [403, unreachable given the two gates already passed], (b) firstUpload && item.price>0 [400 — unreachable through the UI since PriceStep disables the Paid toggle whenever firstUpload is true, so price can never be nonzero here], (c) inUse >= creator.slotsTotal [409, all-slots-in-use at actual submit time, distinct from CreateHub's own pre-check]
uiStatesHandled.reachable: yes for case (c) only, via the dev slot switches or organic slot exhaustion; (a) and (b) are guarded out by the UI itself and only reachable by calling contentApi.publish() directly, bypassing the component.

uiStatesHandled.state: PublishingWizard — resubmit mode (title/type prefilled, 'Fix ·' header, 'Resubmit for review' CTA)
uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: searchParams.resubmit is set and matches a libraryItems entry, passed to PublishingWizard as the resubmit prop
uiStatesHandled.reachable: yes, from ContentLibrary's 'Fix and resubmit' action on a rejected item.

uiStatesHandled.state: PublishingWizard desktop (xl breakpoint) — two-column layout with live buyer-facing preview card
uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: viewport >= xl (Tailwind breakpoint), rendered in parallel with the mobile flow via hidden/xl:flex — not a separate route or fetch
uiStatesHandled.reachable: yes, purely CSS-driven; same underlying state as the mobile step machine, just displayed differently (desktop 'step' progress is recomputed from field-completeness, not the mobile `step` index).

uiStatesDesigned.frame: 1 · Type picker — grouped by how it is delivered
2 · Stream upload — progress plus thumbnail choice
3 · Download upload — file done, cover next
4 · Preview step — creator decides the giveaway
6 · Paid — earnings computed live, Pro upside stated
6b · First upload — explained, not silently blocked
7 · Slots full — upgrade, or free one up
9 · Content list — every state, with sales
uiStatesDesigned.matchesHandled: ContentLibrary — live/review/rejected rows with earnings/activity; design shows all three status pills plus earnings on live rows, matching CreatorUploadCard
